abstract: AIMS: To examine in testicular seminomas the expression of DNA methyltransferase 3B (DNMT3B), which is known to be associated with early embryonic development and carcinogenesis, and to obtain a predictive marker for relapse of stage I seminomas. METHODS AND RESULTS: Immunohistochemical examination of DNMT3B was performed in 88 cases of seminoma, 35 (39.8%) of which showed widely scattered nuclear immunoreactivity for DNMT3B, and 53 (60.2%) of which were completely negative. The incidence of focal DNMT3B expression was higher in stage III seminomas (5/5, 100%) than in stage I (25/70, 35.7%) or stage II (5/13, 38.5%) seminomas (P = 0.011). In stage I seminomas there were no significant correlations between DNMT3B expression and tumour size, invasion of the rete testis, or lymphatic or vascular involvement. Six of 25 cases (24%) showing DNMT3B expression relapsed, whereas only 3/45 cases (6.7%) lacking such expression did so (P = 0.037). Patients with seminomas showing DNMT3B expression had a significantly lower relapse-free survival rate than patients whose tumours lacked this feature (P = 0.0464). CONCLUSIONS: Patients with seminomas showing focal DNMT3B expression are at increased risk of relapse, and should be followed up carefully.
abstract_ja: 目的：セミノーマにおけるDNMT3B（胚発生および発がんとの関連が知られるDNAメチルトランスフェラーゼ3B）の発現を検討し、病期Iセミノーマの再発を予測するマーカーを得ること。方法と結果：精巣セミノーマ88例でDNMT3Bの免疫組織化学染色を行った。35例（39.8%）が広範に散在する核陽性を示し、53例（60.2%）は完全に陰性であった。巣状のDNMT3B発現の頻度は、病期III（5/5、100%）が病期I（25/70、35.7%）または病期II（5/13、38.5%）より高かった（P = 0.011）。病期Iセミノーマでは、DNMT3B発現と腫瘍径、精巣網への浸潤、リンパ管または血管浸潤との間に有意な相関は認められなかった。DNMT3B発現を示した25例のうち6例（24%）が再発したのに対し、発現を認めなかった45例では3例（6.7%）のみが再発した（P = 0.037）。DNMT3B発現を示すセミノーマ症例は、発現を認めない腫瘍に比べ無再発生存率が有意に低かった（P = 0.0464）。結論：巣状のDNMT3B発現を示すセミノーマ患者は再発リスクが高く、注意深いフォローアップが必要である。
